displayedInputs.question: Which of the following surveys is suitable for a census?

choices.A: Finding out the lifespan of a batch of light bulbs
choices.B: Finding out the weights of 45 students in a class
choices.C: Finding out how audiences nationwide rate a particular film
choices.D: Finding out the water quality of the Yangtze River

displayedInputs.question: Which of the following investigations is most suitable for sampling?

choices.A: Inspecting all components of a spacecraft before launch
choices.B: Giving new students medical examinations upon enrollment
choices.D: Testing the lethal radius of a batch of artillery shells

displayedInputs.question: Which of the following statements about censuses and sample surveys is correct?

choices.A: Census results are always more accurate than sample survey results, so a census should be used in every situation
choices.B: Sample survey results exactly match the true characteristics of the population
choices.C: Sampling is appropriate when the investigation is destructive or there are many subjects
choices.D: Sampling should be used to learn about 3 competition prizewinners at a school

displayedInputs.question: To learn about the physical fitness of 30,000 ninth-grade students in a city, 1000 students are selected for testing. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.A: The population is the physical fitness scores of 1000 students
choices.B: The sample is the 1000 selected students
choices.C: An individual is each ninth-grade student's physical fitness score

displayedInputs.question: To learn about students' eyesight at a school, some students are randomly selected. The sample size is 120, which is exactly 5% of the total number of students at the school. How many students are there at the school?

choices.A: No, the sample is not representative
choices.B: Yes, basketball team members are also students at the school
choices.C: Yes, as long as enough people are surveyed

displayedInputs.question: To find out the average height of all students at a school, which of the following sampling methods is most reasonable?

choices.B: Measuring only the school basketball team members
choices.D: Randomly selecting 100 people from the list of all students at the school
